name: app-shell-topbar-journal
title: Journal top bar · section pills, sidebar page search and an inset notifications sheet
description: Journal top bar · section pills, sidebar page search and an inset notifications sheet. Blocks/App Shell pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/blocks/AppShell and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in block built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:g-udi/design-system. Demo assets referenced (supply your own or copy them into public/): /avatars/person-07.svg, /avatars/person-41.svg, /avatars/person-46.svg.
